name: pie-chart
title: Pie and donut chart
description: A pie or donut drawn with the theme chart colours (--chart-1 to --chart-8), with a legend that lists every value in words. The legend is the data: components.js reads each item's data-value and draws the slices, so the chart follows the theme.
whenToUse: Shares of one whole with 2 to 6 parts (budget by channel, volume by market). For more parts, or to compare sizes across groups, use a bar chart or a table. Put the chart in a card body or an accordion section; it sits flush there.

variants.description: Pie with legend. Wrap in <figure class="tx-pie" data-tx-pie>; each tx-pie__item has data-value (any unit). Slice colours follow item order.
Donut with the total in the centre (tx-pie__center).
Optional empty span in a legend item; the script fills in its percentage of the total.

a11y: The chart is role="img" with an aria-label the script writes from the legend (for example 'TV 38%, Digital 27%…'), and the legend shows every label and value as text, so colour is never the only cue. Keep the figcaption as the chart's name.
